name: git-config-user-name-is-not-gated
note: GUARD: `git config user.name Alice` sets an innocuous identity key, not a hijack key (url.insteadOf / core.hooksPath / core.fsmonitor), so bash-git-config-hijack does not fire and git.config:hijack is never surfaced. Fails closed to gommage; it does NOT become an ask_picto for git.config:hijack.
